text: Chemical Engineering is the science and technology that studies the transformation of substances, energy transfer and substance separation in process industries represented by the chemical industry, aiming to achieve the scale, efficiency and intelligence of chemical processes through engineering principles and technical means. This major integrates chemistry, physics, mathematics and engineering, focusing on transforming chemical reactions or separation processes in the laboratory into practical applications in industrial production. It covers multiple fields such as petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy and environmental protection.
